loginHeroDesc: Design connections, define providers, and publish versioned APIs. Keep control over credentials, contracts, and recovery.
loginDesc: Use your scoped access token to enter the self-hosted control plane.
tokenHelp: The initial administrator token is printed once in the server console.
memoryOnly: Your token stays in this browser tab's memory. It is not stored in localStorage, cookies, or the URL. Reloading requires sign-in again.
dashboardDesc: A clear view of your connections, service contracts, and execution history.
heroDesc: Turn databases and web services into governed, reusable providers. Test first, publish a revision, and keep recovery explicit.
scopedAccessDesc: Roles, tenants, and per-provider API keys.
immutableRevisionsDesc: Editing a draft never changes an existing API revision.
safeRecoveryDesc: Ambiguous writes are quarantined, not blindly retried.
verificationNote: Capability does not imply vendor certification.
connectionsDesc: Configure approved destinations once. Reuse them across your providers.
connectionEditorDesc: Connection credentials are write-only and encrypted in the catalog.
destinationNotice: Network destinations must be approved by the operator through HUB_ALLOWED_ORIGINS or HUB_JDBC_PREFIXES. Private destinations require explicit approval.
name: Name
driverNote: Profiles are connection templates, not proof of tested compatibility. Install the matching driver and run the vendor acceptance suite.
advancedSaved: The JSON shown here is the configuration that will be saved. Review it before saving.
secretWriteOnly: Leave a secret blank to preserve it. Secret values are never returned by the API. Use clearSecrets in the management API to remove a saved value.
invalidJson: The JSON is invalid. Check its syntax.
confirmDelete: Delete this draft or connection? Referenced resources cannot be deleted.
discoveryNotice: JDBC discovery opens a real driver connection. Other adapters show supported capabilities; this is not an upstream health check.
wsdlNotice: Paste a self-contained WSDL. Remote imports and schemas are never fetched automatically.
tablePrompt: Enter the exact table or collection name. For JDBC, one primary-key column is required.
providersDesc: Define inputs, operations, mappings, and resilience. Publish only after testing.
providerEditorDesc: A provider combines a connection, a typed contract, an operation, and a result mapping.
confirmPublish: Publish an immutable revision? Existing published revisions will remain unchanged.
needConnection: Create an approved connection before creating a provider.
slugHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. Must start with a letter.
publishedSnapshotNotice: Saving creates or updates a draft. Existing published revisions keep their provider snapshot. Connection credential rotation is independent.
parameterSourcesHelp: Only INPUT parameters are accepted from callers. CONSTANT, SYSTEM, CONFIG, and SECRET values are resolved by the server. Use exact parameter names in bindings.
fieldsRootHelp: Default /data. Resolve the root first, then map each array item. An empty root selects the complete connector envelope.
mappingHelp: Pointers are relative to the selected root or each selected array item. No mappings returns the selected data unchanged.
safeReadsOnly: 1–4 attempts. Only adapters classified as safe reads may retry.
rateLimitHelp: Sliding window, per access key and provider, within one server process.
idempotencyNotice: Writes require an Idempotency-Key. Automatic retries do not make external writes exactly-once. Ambiguous outcomes require reconciliation.
publishedExecutionNotice: This runs the published revision. It may change destination data. Use a scoped key and controlled test data.
draftExecutionNotice: This executes the saved draft against its configured destination. It is not a dry-run or automatic rollback.
inputOnlyHelp: Provide INPUT parameters only. Unknown or server-resolved parameters are rejected.
runAsync: Submit as a durable background job
responsePlaceholder: Run the provider to inspect its actual response.
reuseKeyNotice: Reuse the key only for the exact same intended operation. Use a new key for a new operation. UNKNOWN does not mean the destination did nothing.
servicesDesc: Stable URLs, immutable provider revisions, and caller-specific access scopes.
serviceUrlNotice: All generated endpoints use POST and require a bearer token. The token determines the tenant. Credentials are never embedded in URLs.
confirmUnpublish: Disable this published revision? Existing consumers of its URL will no longer be able to invoke it.
importNotice: Import a bounded subset of OpenAPI 3.x as editable drafts. Review all imported operations before publishing.
jsonOnly: JSON only. Parameter references are rejected; remote schemas are not fetched.
jobsDesc: Durable submission, visible state transitions, and explicit recovery decisions.
unknownWriteNotice: UNKNOWN means the destination outcome is uncertain. Inspect the destination before reconciling. Automatic replay of ambiguous writes is blocked.
auditDesc: Metadata-only records. Request bodies, results, and credential values are not written to the audit trail.
keysDesc: Grant the smallest required role and provider scope. Rotate and revoke credentials explicitly.
keyNotice: Keys are generated randomly, stored as hashes, and shown once. The bootstrap administrator is privileged and cannot be revoked in this interface.
confirmRevoke: Revoke this access key immediately? Queued jobs using it will fail authentication.
keyEditorDesc: Use a dedicated key for each consumer. Keep administrator credentials out of client applications.
allProvidersExplicit: Explicitly allow all providers in this tenant.
copyOnce: This value is shown only once.
keyCopyWarning: Copy the token to your approved secret manager. Closing this dialog discards the displayed value. Never commit it to GitHub.
settingsDesc: Manage tenant configuration and controlled maintenance. Network policy remains operator-owned.
configValuesHelp: CONFIG parameters resolve keys from this encrypted, tenant-scoped object.
operatorSettingsNotice: Master keys, allowed destinations, bind address, and driver installation are controlled outside the web interface.
runtimeBoundariesDesc: Single-node encrypted catalog. Bounded data sizes and queues. No distributed exactly-once claim, enterprise SSO, or vendor certification is implied.
pruneWarning: Remove completed records older than seven days? Idempotency protection ends for deleted records. UNKNOWN records are retained.
reconcileWarning: Reconcile only after independently checking the destination. An incorrect resolution can conceal an already-applied write. This action is audited.
docsDesc: Implementation, operating boundaries, and deployment guidance in your selected language.
docsUnavailable: Documentation is not bundled yet. See the repository docs directory.
emptyDesc: Create your first resource to start building reusable integrations.
noExecutions: Execution activity appears after you run a provider. No simulated success metrics are shown.
createFirstProvider: Create a provider on an approved connection, then test and publish it.
noPublishedServices: Publish a provider revision or ask an administrator for the required invocation scope.
noJobs: Submit an execution with the durable background-job option to see it here.
error.INTERNAL_ERROR: The server could not complete this request. Use the request ID for investigation.
error.BODY_TOO_LARGE: The request exceeds the size limit.
error.CAPACITY: The configured capacity limit has been reached.
error.CIRCUIT_OPEN: The destination is temporarily suspended after repeated failures.
error.COLUMN_NOT_FOUND: A configured column does not exist.
error.CONFLICT: The operation conflicts with the current state.
error.CONNECTION_TYPE_IMMUTABLE: Create a new connection to change its connector type.
error.CONNECTOR_UNSUPPORTED: This connector type is not supported by this operation.
error.DATABASE_ERROR: The database rejected the operation. Check its restricted server logs.
error.DESTINATION_BLOCKED: The destination is not permitted by the operator network policy.
error.DESTINATION_UNRESOLVED: The destination hostname could not be resolved.
error.DISCOVERY_UNSUPPORTED: Schema discovery is unavailable for this connector.
error.DRIVER_MISSING: Install the required official database driver on the server classpath.
error.DUPLICATE_COLUMN: The result has duplicate column labels. Add distinct SQL aliases.
error.EXECUTION_UNKNOWN: The previous outcome is uncertain. Reconcile it before issuing another write.
error.FORBIDDEN: Your role or provider scope does not permit this operation.
error.GENERATOR_UNSUPPORTED: Automatic CRUD generation is available for JDBC and LOCAL connections.
error.HEADER_BLOCKED: A header is reserved or contains invalid characters.
error.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This idempotency key was already used with different input.
error.IDEMPOTENCY_INVALID: Use an idempotency key with 8–128 letters, digits, dots, colons, underscores or hyphens.
error.IDEMPOTENCY_REQUIRED: This operation requires an Idempotency-Key header.
error.INTERRUPTED: Execution was interrupted. Check the recorded outcome before retrying.
error.INVALID_INPUT: One or more request values are invalid.
error.JOB_NOT_FAILED: Only failed or uncertain read jobs can be retried.
error.JOB_NOT_QUEUED: Only queued jobs can be cancelled.
error.KEY_SELF_REVOKE: The active or bootstrap key cannot be revoked here.
error.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: This HTTP method is not allowed on this endpoint.
error.MISSING_BINDING: A template or SQL binding has no matching parameter.
error.MONGODB_ERROR: The MongoDB driver rejected the operation.
error.MULTI_STATEMENT: Multiple SQL statements are not accepted in one provider.
error.NOT_FOUND: The resource was not found in your workspace.
error.OPENAPI_REFERENCE: Resolve OpenAPI references locally before importing this document.
error.OPERATION_UNSUPPORTED: This connector does not support the selected operation.
error.OUTPUT_MAPPING: The response cannot satisfy the configured output mapping.
error.PAGE_TOO_DEEP: Use a narrower filter or a provider-specific paging query.
error.PARAMETER_TYPE: A parameter cannot be converted to its declared type.
error.POSITIONAL_SQL: Use named SQL parameters such as :customerId instead of question marks.
error.RATE_LIMIT: The request rate limit has been reached. Retry after the indicated interval.
error.RESOURCE_REFERENCED: Other providers or published versions still reference this resource.
error.SCHEMA_REQUIRED: Specify a schema because the table name is ambiguous.
error.SCOPE_REQUIRED: Select providers or explicitly allow all providers for this key.
error.SINGLE_PRIMARY_KEY_REQUIRED: This CRUD operation requires the table's single-column primary key.
error.SLUG_CONFLICT: Another provider already uses this service slug.
error.SLUG_INVALID: Use a lowercase service slug beginning with a letter.
error.SOAP_FAULT: The SOAP endpoint returned a fault.
error.SQL_IDENTIFIER: A table, schema or column identifier is invalid.
error.STORE_INTEGRITY: The encrypted catalog failed integrity verification. Restore a verified backup.
error.STORE_UNAVAILABLE: The catalog could not be committed. Check disk access and free space.
error.TABLE_NOT_FOUND: The configured table was not found in database metadata.
error.UNAUTHORIZED: The access token is missing, invalid, expired or revoked.
error.UNKNOWN_PARAMETER: The request contains a parameter that consumers cannot supply.
error.UNSAFE_RETRY: Automatic retry of a write or unclassified operation is prohibited.
error.UPSTREAM_FORMAT: The upstream response format is invalid.
error.UPSTREAM_REDIRECT: Upstream redirects are blocked. Configure the final approved destination.
error.UPSTREAM_REJECTED: The upstream service rejected the request.
error.UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT: The upstream response exceeded the configured timeout.
error.UPSTREAM_TOO_LARGE: The upstream result exceeds the bounded response limit.
error.UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: The upstream service is temporarily unavailable.
error.VERSION_CONFLICT: The resource changed. Reload it and review the current version.
error.XML_INVALID: The XML is invalid or uses a prohibited external entity or DTD.
error.RECONCILED_NO_EFFECT: An administrator confirmed no upstream effect. A new deliberate operation needs a new key.
